deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 18% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 10.0% = 10-year Treasury 5.0% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). flags: Receivables (money customers still owe) up 111% vs quarterly sales up 86% (days to collect 37 → 42). Customers may be paying more slowly, or sales were pulled forward.
